instruction: Two trains are 400 km apart on the same track and move towards each other. One travels at 55 km/h, the other at 65 km/h. After how many minutes do they meet? Round the answer to the nearest whole minute. Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
